description: The user is brought where they face what the row says (`facing`): a spot the build finds where it is seen ("The user is teleported facing the screws"), on the side the row says ("... to the front of the cabinet, facing the door": `side`, `side_of`), or a viewpoint the row names ("... to VIEW_BACK, facing the screws"), else facing the viewpoint's forward; what they face is never where they go.
